user.title: Buenos Días
user.description: Configure the LLM that writes the morning radio script. Choose the connection mode first; the relevant fields appear on the next step.

data_description.mode: Home Assistant's own conversation agent, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

user_agent.title: Conversation agent
user_agent.description: Pick the Home Assistant conversation agent that writes the script.

data_description.agent: The conversation agent entity to use, e.g. conversation.assist.

user_openai.title: OpenAI-compatible endpoint
user_openai.description: Configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The connection is tested before saving.

data_description.base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
data_description.model: Model name used by the endpoint, e.g. openrouter/free.
data_description.api_key: Optional. Required for cloud providers such as OpenRouter or Groq. Leave empty when reconfiguring to keep the stored key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the LLM connection
reconfigure.description: The API key is left empty to keep the stored one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication required
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the endpoint. Check the URL and network access.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or has no access to the endpoint.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the connection.
error.invalid_url: The base URL is not a valid URL.
error.missing_base_url: A base URL is required in OpenAI-compatible mode.

init.title: Buenos Días options
init.description: Choose which part of the configuration to edit. The LLM connection is edited through the Reconfigure step in the integration overview.

llm.title: LLM options
llm.description: Max output length of the generated script. The connection settings are edited through Reconfigure.

data_description.entity_id: The text-to-speech engine entity, e.g. tts.piper.
data_description.media_player: The speaker the morning radio plays on.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The weather, calendar and sensors read each morning. The RSS feeds (news and events) are edited separately.

data_description.weather: Weather entities to include in the context.
data_description.calendar: Calendar entities to include in the context.
data_description.sensors: Sensor entities to include in the context.

rss_feeds.title: RSS feeds
rss_feeds.description: Click a feed to edit it, or remove it from the editor.

data_description.kind: News feeds are reported as news; event feeds as today's events.
data_description.tags: Optional keywords that describe the feed.
data_description.exclude: A comma- or newline-separated list of keywords, not a regex. Entries whose title or summary/description contains any keyword as a case- and accent-insensitive substring are skipped, e.g. football, gossip.

A comma- or newline-separated list of keywords, not a regex. Entries whose title or summary/description contains any keyword as a case- and accent-insensitive substring are skipped, e.g. football, gossip.
data_description.confirm_remove: Tick this and save to permanently remove the feed.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The alarm uses either a fixed time or a time entity, not both. When a time entity is set, it takes precedence.

data_description.time: Fixed alarm time (HH:MM). Seconds, if any, are ignored. Leave empty when a time entity is set.
data_description.time_entity: Optional sensor that provides the alarm time dynamically, e.g. your phone's alarm sensor. Overrides the fixed time.
data_description.feriados: Dates on which the alarm is skipped, one ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) per line.
data_description.holiday_calendar: Optional calendar entity (e.g. from the Home Assistant Holiday integration) whose all-day events count as holidays and skip the alarm. Leave empty to only use the manual dates above.

persona.title: Persona
persona.description: The persona fully controls the language and style of the spoken script.

error.invalid_feed_url: The feed URL is not valid.
error.invalid_date: Please enter one ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) per line.
error.invalid_feed_index: The selected feed no longer exists.
